# ASMO (逐日)

> ASMO is a free, open-source planner for macOS, written like a document, that coding agents can use. To-dos sync both ways with Apple Calendar and Reminders. Claude Code, Codex and other agents read and change it through the `asmo` command line; apps without a shell use its MCP server (`asmo mcp`). The app runs no language model itself. MIT licensed.

## Key facts

- Platform: Apple silicon Mac, macOS 15 or later. Signed with a Developer ID and notarized.
- Price: free, open source (AGPL-3.0); a commercial licence is needed for closed-source or commercial use of the code. No account, no server of its own, no subscription.
- Apple sync: from today on, timed items are events in a 逐日 calendar and the rest are reminders in a 逐日 list (iCloud); changes and new items made there come back. Repeating items are written a week ahead, one per day; checking one off there marks that day done. `asmo mirror` syncs now; `asmo mirror off` turns it off.
- Data: a local file in ~/Library/Application Support/ASMO; the app is the only writer, and open windows update while an agent works.
- Install: download, unzip, move to Applications, open. The app sets up the asmo command, the Claude Code / Codex skill and the Claude desktop MCP entry by itself.
- Updates: checks GitHub Releases after launch and daily; one click downloads, verifies the signature, swaps the app and reopens it.
- Agent surface: `asmo today | day | list | search | add | set | done | rm | page | pages | attach | routine | date | undo | mirror | mcp`. Answers are JSON.
- Day pages: written in Markdown (headings, emphasis, links, lists, checkboxes, quotes, tables, code blocks, pictures by path or URL, mermaid diagrams drawn by a bundled copy of mermaid). Read back as blocks b1, b2… that can be replaced or removed one at a time.
- Important dates: yearly, Gregorian or Chinese lunar, each kept in a time zone (`asmo date add … --zone Asia/Shanghai`, `asmo date set`); shown and put in Apple Calendar at the moment the day begins there.
- Notes: a folder of Markdown files (an Obsidian vault works as it is: [[links]], ![[pictures]], tables, callouts, $formulas$ via bundled KaTeX, mermaid, ![[note]] embeds, Excalidraw drawings in the plugin's .excalidraw.md format via bundled Excalidraw), edited with a live preview and a home page of recent and older notes; ⌘P searches notes and days; `asmo notes`, `asmo note PATH`, `asmo note write PATH [--append|--new]`, `asmo note search`, `asmo note mv`, `asmo note rm`; MCP: list_notes, read_note, write_note, search_notes, move_note, remove_note. A Git-repository folder syncs with its remote by itself.
- Undo: `asmo undo` takes back changes made through the command until the app restarts.
- Interface: English and Chinese; content is never translated.
